name: Is it better to spray or brush and roll interior doors?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to spray or brush and roll interior doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spraying produces an ultra-smooth, factory-like finish without visible brush lines, making it ideal for multi-door renovations where slabs can be taken to a dedicated workspace. However, spraying requires extensive masking and equipment setup. Brushing and rolling is more practical for occupied homes or individual door updates because it creates less airborne overspray. Using a high-density foam roller on flat sections and a fine-bristle angle brush inside recessed panels gives a very smooth finish with minimal setup.
acceptedAnswer.description: Spraying delivers the smoothest, factory-grade finish for large projects, while brushing and rolling creates less mess and is ideal for individual rooms.
